d: US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy has revealed new details about the communications failure that triggered a nationwide FAA ground stop, disrupting thousands of flights. Investigators are examining whether routine telecommunications maintenance by contractor L3Harris caused the breakdown, with a faulty installation, configuration or router among the possibilities. FAA Administrator Bryan Bedford says the agency has identified the fault but is still determining the exact defective equipment, while ruling out evidence of malicious activity or AI involvement.
